```yaml
name: Release
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
      - name: Run release-please
        id: release-please
        uses: googleapis/release-please-action@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          release-type: simple
          path: .
          target-branch: main
          config-file: .github/release-please-config.json
          manifest-file: .github/manifest.json
          repo-url: ${{ github.repository }}
          github-api-url: https://api.github.com
          github-graphql-url: https://api.github.com/graphql
          fork: true
          include-component-in-tag: false
          proxy-server: ''
          skip-github-release: false
          skip-github-pull-request: false
          skip-labeling: false
      - name: Run nova_request_app workflow
        if: steps.release-please.outputs.release_created == 'true'
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const repo = context.payload.pull_request?.head?.repo?.full_name || context.repository.full;
            await github.rest.actions.createWorkflowDispatch({
              owner: 'novaframework',
              repo: 'nova_request_app',
              workflow_id: 'release.yml',
              ref: 'main',
              inputs: {
                branch: context.ref.replace('refs/heads/', ''),
                nova_repo: repo
              }
            });
```
